subject: Mutual Action Plan: security acceptance & DPA questions
messages:
From: Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@orbitbank.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: OrbitBank Legal <legal@orbitbank.com>
Date: 2028-03-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual Action Plan & security acceptance details

Hi Sofia / Redwood team,

Thanks for the demo last week — OrbitBank is ready to move into a pilot but we need to align on the MAP security gates before we commit to timelines. High-level ask list from our legal and InfoSec:

- SOC 2 Type II: copy or attestation and timing for next audit if Type II is older than 12 months.
- SIG/CAIQ: completed questionnaire or statement of which sections you can provide evidence for now.
- DPA: our legal team will send redlines; we need an owner on your side to coordinate.
- Data retention: details on default retention windows for transaction logs, embeddings, and full-text indexes; ability to configure retention per-tenant.
- Evidence delivery: preferred mechanism for transferring artifacts (secure Drive vs temporary S3 presigned links).

Attached is our MAP template (OrbitBank_MAP_v1.pdf) — please fill section 2 (Security Acceptance) and propose dates for each gate. Our target is to start pilot the week of Apr 8, but that depends on the SOC2 + DPA cadence.

Can you confirm: who on your side will own DPA redlines, and whether Redwood can complete a CAIQ export within 10 business days?

Regards,
Natalie Gomez
Director, Vendor Risk & Controls
OrbitBank

Attachments: OrbitBank_MAP_v1.pdf
From: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@orbitbank.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-11T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & security acceptance details

Hi Natalie — thanks for the clear MAP template, this is very helpful. High-level responses and a proposed acceptance timeline below. I copied our legal and compliance leads for redlines and evidence intake.

Quick answers:
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending Nov 2027. We will provide the report PDF and the auditor contact to OrbitBank by 2028-03-14.
- SIG/CAIQ: We can export a CAIQ/CCM package. We propose delivering a completed CAIQ export + evidence index within 10 business days after we finalize the MAP section scope.
- DPA: Laura Bennett will own DPA redlines on the Redwood side (cc'd). She will coordinate with your legal team and can take the first pass within 3 business days of receiving your redlines.
- Data retention: Redwood default retention policy for hosted accounts is:
  * Transaction logs: 30 days active, 365 days archived (encrypted).
  * Embeddings & model inputs: 30 days by default; can be shortened to 0-7 days for PII-sensitive pilots.
  * Full-text indices (search): configurable, default 90 days.
  We can make per-tenant overrides for Pilot accounts (we are OK with OrbitBank asking for 90-day transaction logs during pilot; long-term retention should be in the MAP).
- Evidence delivery: we prefer a shared, access-limited Drive folder for artifacts and can post short-lived presigned S3 links for sensitive reports.

Proposed MAP security acceptance timeline (draft):
- 2028-03-14: Redwood delivers SOC2 PDF + auditor contact; Redwood uploads CAIQ export draft to shared Drive.
- 2028-03-21: Redwood delivers the CAIQ + evidence index.
- 2028-03-24: Legal redlines on DPA returned by OrbitBank; Laura to provide first-pass redline to OrbitBank by 2028-03-28.
- 2028-04-03: Mutual agreement on DPA and final sign-off via DocuSign; security acceptance complete.

If OrbitBank needs adjusted retention windows for pilot, we can make those changes in the MAP and implement them as feature flags for the pilot tenant.

Next steps:
1) Natalie — can you confirm that the proposed 03/14 SOC2 delivery and 03/21 CAIQ delivery work for your reviewers?
2) OrbitBank legal — please send DPA redlines to laura.bennett@redwood.ai (cc Sofia) when ready.

Link to our shared MAP folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_map_docs

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Head of Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Summary_2027.pdf, Redwood_DPA_Draft_v3.docx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-12T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & security acceptance details (internal)

Looping in a few quick operational details for the MAP execution:

- SIG/CAIQ owner: Rishi will coordinate with Applied ML to assemble the evidence index. Aim: CAIQ export + evidence pointers within 10 business days after Sofia confirms scope.
- Evidence access: use the shared Drive for non-sensitive artifacts and generate presigned S3 links for the SOC2 report and any raw auditor attachments. Links will be TTL 7 days.
- Retention implementation: Platform team can apply tenant-level retention flags for Pilot accounts. Marissa, can you create a Pilot tenant with retention windows: transaction logs=90d, embeddings=30d, search index=90d? Target creation: 2028-03-16.
- DocuSign: Marissa, prep the DPA envelope template so legal can drop in the final redline quickly.

Short action items:
* Marissa: create pilot tenant + DPA envelope template (due 2028-03-16).
* Laura: own DPA redline coordination with OrbitBank legal.
* Rishi: CAIQ evidence index (start 2028-03-12).

Thanks — this should keep us on track for the April pilot start if we hit these dates.

-Rishi
Senior Product Manager, Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Natalie Gomez <natalie.gomez@orbitbank.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: OrbitBank Legal <legal@orbitbank.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, rishi.malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-03-13T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan & security acceptance details

Thanks Sofia — that timeline looks reasonable and the proposed approach should work for our reviewers. A couple of clarifications from our side before we finalize MAP dates:

- Retention: For the pilot we want transaction logs at 90 days and embeddings at 30 days (you're OK with that). For production we'll need contractual language in the MAP/DPA that allows for a maximum of 365 days archival for transaction-level artifacts; can you commit to that in the DPA?
- SOC2: please include auditor contact and whether you will allow a vendor-to-vendor security call between OrbitBank and your auditor (we prefer that but it's optional).
- CAIQ evidence: request that your CAIQ export include sample artifact IDs for each answered control (we use those to speed internal review).
- DocuSign: will your team accept a single DocuSign envelope for both the DPA and MAP signature, or do you prefer separate flows?

On timing: our legal team will aim to send redlines by 2028-03-17. If Redwood can deliver the SOC2 copy + auditor contact by 2028-03-14 and the CAIQ by 03-21, we will target DocuSign signature the week of 03-28 and kickoff pilot the week of 04-08.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
